aiSimulator.response:
CGPDTM Tech Internship Highlights (Apr 2026 – Sep 2026):
• IP Saarthi 2.0: Architected a high-accuracy conversational GenAI assistant using Python, LLMs, and prompt engineering to guide users through Indian Patent, Trademark, and Design queries.
• Autonomous Text-to-SQL: Engineered an autonomous agent on SQL Server automating schema discovery, query validation, and generating real-time tabular and chart visualizations.
• Document Intelligence & OCR: Built an end-to-end legal document RAG pipeline with custom OCR, semantic chunking, and FAISS vector retrieval.
• BLOB Automation: Automated high-volume Trademark binary BLOB data pipelines for seamless preprocessing.

Multi-Agent SQL AI System Architecture:
• Vector Schema Retrieval: Database schemas & sample queries are embedded and indexed into FAISS.
• RAG & Ollama Inference: User input (multilingual) is retrieved with the schema context and synthesized into SQL via local Ollama models (privacy-first).
• Guardrail & Execution: Queries pass through an AST-level syntax sanitizer to prevent destructive commands (DROP/DELETE) before safe execution on SQLite/Postgres.
• Output: Generates both raw tabular datasets and automated dynamic charts.

Image Captioning with Object Detection (YOLOv8 + VGG16):
• Dual Feature Extraction: Combines spatial image embeddings from VGG16 with contextual semantic object labels predicted in real-time by YOLOv8.
• Tag Injection: Detected object tags are appended to context tokens, yielding a ~40% precision improvement in generating accurate descriptive captions.
• CNN-LSTM & Beam Search: Decodes coherent sentences using n-best hypothesis beam search over the Flickr8k benchmark.
• CustomTkinter GUI: Integrated a clean desktop app for instant image drag-and-drop and caption generation.
